Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the definition of farm vehicle.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the definition of farm vehicle; and amending RCW46.04.181.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.04.181 and 1967 c 202 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: "Farm vehicle" means any vehicle other than a farm tractor or farmimplement which is: (1) Designed and/or used primarily in agriculturalpursuits on farms for the purpose of transporting machinery, equipment,implements, farm products, supplies and/or farm labor thereon and isonly incidentally operated on or moved along public highways for thepurpose of going from one farm to another; or (2) for purposes of RCW46.25.050, used to transport agricultural products to or from a farm.
